_comment: Machine-readable deployment truth (HOD-715). Every 'is X deployed' claim in the docs is DERIVED from this file by scripts/deployment_status.py and guarded by `make check-docs`, because hand-maintained executed/not-executed prose drifted once: the README said asymmetric signing 'has not been built' for a commit after it was built, and an external review caught it. A capability may only be 'verified' if it names the evidence that verified it AND when — the generator refuses the file otherwise.

status_vocabulary.verified: Checked against the live deployment; evidence_source and last_verified_utc are both required and are what makes the claim admissible.
status_vocabulary.provisioned_unverified: Provisioned on the project, but no verification run has confirmed the property since. Reported as unverified, never as working.
status_vocabulary.scripted_not_executed: A reproducible script exists in this repo and has never been run against the live project. This is a designed capability, not a deployed one.
status_vocabulary.in_process_only: Enforced inside the single application process. Real, testable, and NOT a cloud-infrastructure boundary — stated so the difference cannot be blurred.

evidence_endpoint.detail: Cloud Run service serving /works, /.well-known/hodi.json, /canaries, /evidence-counts, and logging every access to Firestore since 2026-08-06.
evidence_endpoint.evidence_source: docs/metrics.json :: daily_crawler_accrual_metrics (live Firestore audit, 1613 accrued records)

append_only_runtime_identity.detail: The deployed process runs as hodi-runtime-sa, whose effective permissions exclude datastore.entities.update and .delete, so grant history cannot be rewritten at runtime.
append_only_runtime_identity.evidence_source: scripts/deploy.sh step 3 + tests/test_grant_log_iam.py::TestDeployedRuntimeIdentityCannotRewriteHistory (HODI_E2E, reads roles back from IAM)

cross_buyer_boundary_over_network.detail: The 2026-08-07 unauthenticated cross-buyer exploit and its variants are refused by the deployed service; 6/6 HTTP 403 including the mutating and internal routes.
cross_buyer_boundary_over_network.evidence_source: make demo-live (scripts/test_live_cross_counterparty.py) — Parts A, B, C

gemini_scope_interpretation.detail: POST /api/v1/license/natural performs one server-side Vertex AI generateContent call against the pinned gemini-3.5-flash on the global endpoint.

conflict_domain_separation.detail: Which agent may read whose data is enforced by the policy gateway inside ONE Cloud Run process, using the same iam_policy.py data the generated matrix renders. This is an application-layer boundary, not a GCP IAM boundary. The role/service-account BINDING is now checked on every call (HOD-717), and the OIDC-verified path plus strict mode (HODI_REQUIRE_VERIFIED_IDENTITY=1, which refuses in-process identities outright) are implemented and tested — but this deployment does NOT run in strict mode, because strict mode is only satisfiable once the services are split. So caller identity here remains trusted-by-construction: exactly as trustworthy as the process, and no more.
conflict_domain_separation.evidence_source: src/gateway/gateway.py + tests/test_gateway_session_scope.py (offline); make demo-live (deployed, over the network)

kms_signing.detail: Cloud KMS asymmetric signing of receipts, notices and incident manifests. The signing code path, the verifier and /verification-key all exist and are tested offline against an ephemeral key; the KMS keyring has never been created on the live project, so the DEPLOYED service emits labelled UNSIGNED_PLACEHOLDER values today.
kms_signing.evidence_source: scripts/setup_kms_signing.sh (never run); tests/test_signing.py covers the code path offline

per_domain_databases.detail: Named Firestore databases per conflict domain with per-SA IAM conditions, so a foreign-domain read fails at Google IAM rather than at the application layer.
per_domain_databases.evidence_source: scripts/setup_workload_identity.sh (never run); tests/test_workload_identity.py::TestForeignDomainReadIsDeniedByIAM is written and HODI_E2E-gated

split_revocation_worker.detail: The revocation worker as its own Cloud Run service under the revocation-propagator SA — real workload identity, and the killable isolation an in-process daemon thread cannot provide.

durable_trace_backend.detail: Cloud Trace export of the delegation spans (HODI_TRACE_EXPORT=cloud). The exporter selection is tested offline; no deployment has run with it enabled, so no waterfall has been captured from a backend.

scheduled_jobs.detail: Cloud Scheduler runs hodi-daily-accrual-audit (09:00 UTC) and hodi-nightly-teardown-trigger (23:00 UTC), with visible execution history.
scheduled_jobs.evidence_source: docs/metrics.json :: daily_crawler_accrual_metrics (audit rows persisted by the scheduled job); Google-Cloud-Scheduler appears in distinct_user_agents
